imported_frank_assumptions: FRANK architecture is Clay/ClayCode-native and Harness is executable developmental evidence.
Execution authority remains separate from model/package declarations.
independent_support: Official package/build ecosystems independently distinguish exact resolution/content identity from some combination of resolver state, trust/freshness and builder provenance.

The hosted mutation suite independently exercises identity-boundary counterexamples, but shares this worker's encoded oracle and therefore is mechanism evidence rather than independent scientific replication.
echo_risks: Do not count FRANK authority separation and ClayCode authority separation as two independent evidence sources; they share project ancestry.
Do not count synthetic mutation results as independent confirmation of the contract they were designed to test.
Do not treat multiple external ecosystems as statistically independent proof of one optimal ClayCode design; they are engineering analogies with different threat models.
counterevidence_preserved: Different ecosystems legitimately choose different resolver policies and lock representations.
A monolithic hash can maximize change sensitivity but overcouples semantic identity to mutable policy/provenance state.
Separating trust state from semantic identity requires an enforceable admissibility gate; otherwise it could permit reuse of newly disallowed artifacts.
